159: static void buf_vprintf(struct buf *buf, const char *fmt, va_list args)
160: {
161:     va_list ap;

164:     /* Copy args in case we have to try again */
165:     va_copy(ap, args);

167:     size = buf->alloc - buf->len;
168:     n = (size_t)vsnprintf(buf->s + buf->len, size, fmt, args);

170:     if (n >= size) {
171:         /* Grow the buffer and try again */
172:         size = n + BUF_GROW;
173:         buf->alloc += size;
174:         buf->s = icalmemory_resize_buffer(buf->s, buf->alloc);
175: 
176:         n = (size_t)vsnprintf(buf->s + buf->len, size, fmt, ap);
177:     }
178:     va_end(ap);
179: 
180:     buf->len += n;
181: }

195:         }                                \

200: static int _parse_param_name(struct vcardparser_state *state)
201: {
202:     vcardparameter_kind kind;
203:     const char *name;
204: 
205:     while (*state->p) {
206:         /* Handle control characters and break for NUL char */
207:         HANDLECTRL(state);
208: 
209:         switch (*state->p) {
210:         case '=':
211:             name = buf_cstring(&state->buf);
212:             kind = vcardparameter_string_to_kind(name);
213:             state->param = vcardparameter_new(kind);
214:             if (kind == VCARD_X_PARAMETER) {
215:                 vcardparameter_set_xname(state->param, name);
216:             } else if (kind == VCARD_IANA_PARAMETER) {
217:                 vcardparameter_set_iana_name(state->param, name);
218:             }
219:             buf_reset(&state->buf);
220:             INC(1);
221:             return 0;
222: 
223:         case ';': /* vCard 2.1 parameter with just a value */
224:         case ':':
225:             state->param = vcardparameter_new(VCARD_TYPE_PARAMETER);
226:             /* no INC - we need to see this char up a layer */
227:             return 0;
228: 
229:         case '\r':
230:             INC(1);
231:             break; /* just skip */
232:         case '\n':
233:             if (state->p[1] != ' ' && state->p[1] != '\t') {
234:                 return PE_KEY_EOL;
235:             }
236:             INC(2);
237:             break;
238: 
239:         /* XXX - check exact legal set? */
240:         default:
241:             PUTC(*state->p);
242:             INC(1);
243:             break;
244:         }
245:     }
246: 
247:     return PE_KEY_EOF;
248: }

250: /* just leaves it on the buffer */
251: static int _parse_param_quoted(struct vcardparser_state *state,
252:                                bool is_structured, bool is_multivalued)
253: {
254:     NOTESTART();
255: 
256:     while (*state->p) {
257:         /* Handle control characters and break for NUL char */
258:         HANDLECTRL(state);
259: 
260:         switch (*state->p) {
261:         case '"':
262:             INC(1);
263:             return 0;
264: 
265:         /* normal backslash quoting - NOTE, not strictly RFC compliant,
266:          * but I figure anyone who generates one PROBABLY meant to escape
267:          * the next character because it's so common, and LABEL definitely
268:          * allows \n, so we have to handle that anyway */
269:         case '\\':
270:             /* seen in the wild - \n split by line wrapping */
271:             if (state->p[1] == '\r') {
272:                 INC(1);
273:             }
274:             if (state->p[1] == '\n') {
275:                 if (state->p[2] != ' ' && state->p[2] != '\t') {
276:                     return PE_QSTRING_EOL;
277:                 }
278:                 INC(2);
279:             }
280:             if (!state->p[1]) {
281:                 return PE_BACKQUOTE_EOF;
282:             }
283:             if (state->p[1] == 'n' || state->p[1] == 'N') {
284:                 PUTC('\n');
285:             } else if (is_structured && strchr(";,", state->p[1])) {
286:                 // preserve escaped COMMA and SEMICOLON in structured value
287:                 PUTC(state->p[0]);
288:                 PUTC(state->p[1]);
289:             } else {
290:                 PUTC(state->p[1]);
291:             }
292:             INC(2);
293:             break;
294: 
295:         /* special value quoting for doublequote and endline (RFC 6868) */
296:         case '^':
297:             if (state->p[1] == '\r') {
298:                 INC(1);
299:             }
300:             if (state->p[1] == '\n') {
301:                 if (state->p[2] != ' ' && state->p[2] != '\t') {
302:                     return PE_QSTRING_EOL;
303:                 }
304:                 INC(2);
305:             }
306:             if (state->p[1] == '\'') {
307:                 PUTC('"');
308:                 INC(2);
309:             } else if (state->p[1] == 'n') { /* only lower case per the RFC */
310:                 PUTC('\n');
311:                 INC(2);
312:             } else if (state->p[1] == '^') {
313:                 PUTC('^');
314:                 INC(2);
315:             } else {
316:                 PUTC('^');
317:                 INC(1); /* treat next char normally */
318:             }
319:             break;
320: 
321:         case '\r':
322:             INC(1);
323:             break; /* just skip */
324:         case '\n':
325:             if (state->p[1] != ' ' && state->p[1] != '\t') {
326:                 return PE_QSTRING_EOL;
327:             }
328:             INC(2);
329:             break;
330: 
331:         case ',':
332:             if (is_multivalued && !is_structured) {
333:                 return PE_QSTRING_EOV;
334:             }
335:             /* or fall through, comma isn't special */
336:             _fallthrough();
337: 
338:         default:
339:             PUTC(*state->p);
340:             INC(1);
341:             break;
342:         }
343:     }
344: 
345:     return PE_QSTRING_EOF;
346: }

348: static int _parse_param_value(struct vcardparser_state *state)
349: {
350:     bool is_multivalued = vcardparameter_is_multivalued(state->param);
351:     bool is_structured = vcardparameter_is_structured(state->param);
352:     int r;
353: 
354:     while (*state->p) {
355:         /* Handle control characters and break for NUL char */
356:         HANDLECTRL(state);
357: 
358:         switch (*state->p) {
359:         case '\\': /* normal backslash quoting */
360:             /* seen in the wild - \n split by line wrapping */
361:             if (state->p[1] == '\r') {
362:                 INC(1);
363:             }
364:             if (state->p[1] == '\n') {
365:                 if (state->p[2] != ' ' && state->p[2] != '\t') {
366:                     return PE_PARAMVALUE_EOL;
367:                 }
368:                 INC(2);
369:             }
370:             if (!state->p[1]) {
371:                 return PE_BACKQUOTE_EOF;
372:             }
373:             if (state->p[1] == 'n' || state->p[1] == 'N') {
374:                 PUTC('\n');
375:             } else {
376:                 PUTC(state->p[1]);
377:             }
378:             INC(2);
379:             break;
380: 
381:         case '^': /* special value quoting for doublequote (RFC 6868) */
382:             /* seen in the wild - \n split by line wrapping */
383:             if (state->p[1] == '\r') {
384:                 INC(1);
385:             }
386:             if (state->p[1] == '\n') {
387:                 if (state->p[2] != ' ' && state->p[2] != '\t') {
388:                     return PE_PARAMVALUE_EOL;
389:                 }
390:                 INC(2);
391:             }
392:             if (state->p[1] == '\'') {
393:                 PUTC('"');
394:                 INC(2);
395:             } else if (state->p[1] == 'n') {
396:                 PUTC('\n');
397:                 INC(2);
398:             } else if (state->p[1] == '^') {
399:                 PUTC('^');
400:                 INC(2);
401:             } else {
402:                 PUTC('^');
403:                 INC(1); /* treat next char normally */
404:             }
405:             break;
406: 
407:         case '"':
408:             INC(1);
409:             while ((r = _parse_param_quoted(state,
410:                                             is_structured,
411:                                             is_multivalued)) == PE_QSTRING_EOV) {
412:                 vcardparameter_add_value_from_string(state->param,
413:                                                      buf_cstring(&state->buf));
414: 
415:                 buf_reset(&state->buf);
416:                 INC(1);
417:             }
418:             if (r) {
419:                 return r;
420:             }
421:             break;
422: 
423:         case ':':
424:         case ';':
425:             /* done - end of parameter */
426:             if (is_multivalued) {
427:                 vcardparameter_add_value_from_string(state->param,
428:                                                      buf_cstring(&state->buf));
429:             } else {
430:                 vcardparameter_set_value_from_string(state->param,
431:                                                      buf_cstring(&state->buf));
432: 
433:                 /* if it is a VALUE parameter, set the value kind */
434:                 if (vcardparameter_isa(state->param) == VCARD_VALUE_PARAMETER) {
435:                     vcardvalue_kind kind =
436:                         vcardvalue_string_to_kind(buf_cstring(&state->buf));
437:                     if (kind != VCARD_NO_VALUE) {
438:                         state->value_kind = kind;
439:                     }
440:                 }
441:             }
442: 
443:             buf_reset(&state->buf);
444:             /* no INC - we need to see this char up a layer */
445:             return 0;
446: 
447:         case '\r':
448:             INC(1);
449:             break; /* just skip */
450: 
451:         case '\n':
452:             if (state->p[1] != ' ' && state->p[1] != '\t') {
453:                 return PE_PARAMVALUE_EOL;
454:             }
455:             INC(2);
456:             break;
457: 
458:         case ',':
459:             if (is_multivalued) {
460:                 vcardparameter_add_value_from_string(state->param,
461:                                                      buf_cstring(&state->buf));
462:                 buf_reset(&state->buf);
463:                 INC(1);
464:                 break;
465:             }
466:             /* or fall through, comma isn't special */
467:             _fallthrough();
468: 
469:         default:
470:             PUTC(*state->p);
471:             INC(1);
472:             break;
473:         }
474:     }
475: 
476:     return PE_PARAMVALUE_EOF;
477: }

503: {
504:     vcardproperty_kind prop_kind = vcardproperty_isa(state->prop);
505:     const char *group = vcardproperty_get_group(state->prop);

507:     do {
508:         int r;
509: 
510:         INC(1); /* skip ';' */

512:         NOTESTART();
513: 
514:         /* get the name */
515:         r = _parse_param_name(state);
516:         if (r) {

518:                          VCARD_XLICERRORTYPE_PARAMETERNAMEPARSEERROR,
519:                          "%s '%s' in %s%s%s property. Removing entire property",
520:                          vcardparser_errstr(r), buf_cstring(&state->buf),
521:                          group ? group : "", group ? "." : "",
522:                          vcardproperty_kind_to_string(prop_kind));
523:             return r;
524:         }
525: 
526:         vcardproperty_add_parameter(state->prop, state->param);
527: 
528:         /* now get the value */
529:         r = _parse_param_value(state);
530:         if (r) {
531:             vcardparameter_kind param_kind = vcardparameter_isa(state->param);

535:                          "%s for %s in %s%s%s property. Removing entire property",
536:                          vcardparser_errstr(r),
537:                          vcardparameter_kind_to_string(param_kind),
538:                          group ? group : "", group ? "." : "",
539:                          vcardproperty_kind_to_string(prop_kind));
540:             return r;
541:         }
542: 
543:     } while (*state->p == ';'); /* another parameter to parse */
544: 
545:     return 0;
546: }

548: static int _parse_prop_name(struct vcardparser_state *state)
549: {
550:     const char *name;
551:     const char *group = NULL;
552:     vcardproperty_kind kind;
553:     vcardproperty_version version = VCARD_VERSION_NONE;
554:     int r = 0;
555: 
556:     NOTESTART();
557: 
558:     while (*state->p) {
559:         /* Handle control characters and break for NUL char */
560:         HANDLECTRL(state);
561: 
562:         switch (*state->p) {
563:         case ':':
564:         case ';':
565:             name = buf_cstring(&state->buf);
566:             kind = vcardproperty_string_to_kind(name);
567: 
568:             state->prop = vcardproperty_new(kind);
569:             if (!state->prop) {
570:                 return PE_NAME_INVALID;
571:             }
572: 
573:             if (kind == VCARD_X_PROPERTY) {
574:                 vcardproperty_set_x_name(state->prop, name);
575:             }
576: 
577:             if (group) {
578:                 vcardproperty_set_group(state->prop, group);
579:             }
580: 
581:             if (state->version) {
582:                 version = vcardproperty_get_version(state->version);
583:             }
584: 
585:             /* set default value kind */
586:             switch (kind) {
587:             case VCARD_GEO_PROPERTY:
588:                 state->value_kind = version == VCARD_VERSION_40 ? VCARD_URI_VALUE : VCARD_GEO_VALUE;
589:                 break;
590: 
591:             case VCARD_KEY_PROPERTY:
592:             case VCARD_LOGO_PROPERTY:
593:             case VCARD_PHOTO_PROPERTY:
594:             case VCARD_SOUND_PROPERTY:
595:                 state->value_kind = version == VCARD_VERSION_40 ? VCARD_URI_VALUE : VCARD_TEXT_VALUE;
596:                 break;
597: 
598:             case VCARD_TZ_PROPERTY:
599:                 state->value_kind = version == VCARD_VERSION_40 ? VCARD_TEXT_VALUE : VCARD_UTCOFFSET_VALUE;
600:                 break;
601: 
602:             case VCARD_UID_PROPERTY:
603:                 state->value_kind = version == VCARD_VERSION_40 ? VCARD_URI_VALUE : VCARD_TEXT_VALUE;
604:                 break;
605: 
606:             case VCARD_X_PROPERTY:
607:                 state->value_kind =
608:                     xprop_value_kind_func ? xprop_value_kind_func(name, xprop_value_kind_data)
609:                                           : VCARD_X_VALUE;
610:                 break;
611: 
612:             default:
613:                 state->value_kind = vcardproperty_kind_to_value_kind(kind);
614:                 break;
615:             }
616: 
617:             buf_reset(&state->buf);
618: 
619:             /* no INC - we need to see this char up a layer */
620:             return r;
621: 
622:         case '.':
623:             if (group) {
624:                 size_t tmpLen = strlen(group) + buf_len(&state->buf) + 2;
625:                 char *tmp = icalmemory_tmp_buffer(tmpLen);
626:                 snprintf(tmp, tmpLen - 1, "%s.%s", group, buf_cstring(&state->buf));
627:                 group = tmp;
628:                 r = PE_PROP_MULTIGROUP;
629:             } else {
630:                 group = icalmemory_tmp_copy(buf_cstring(&state->buf));
631:             }
632:             buf_reset(&state->buf);
633:             INC(1);
634:             break;
635: 
636:         case '\r':
637:             INC(1);
638:             break; /* just skip */
639:         case '\n':
640:             if (state->p[1] == ' ' || state->p[1] == '\t') { /* wrapped line */
641:                 INC(2);
642:             } else if (!state->buf.len) {
643:                 /* no key yet?  blank intermediate lines are OK */
644:                 INC(1);
645:             } else {
646:                 return PE_NAME_EOL;
647:             }
648:             break;
649: 
650:         default:
651:             PUTC(*state->p);
652:             INC(1);
653:             break;
654:         }
655:     }
656: 
657:     return PE_NAME_EOF;
658: }

660: static int _parse_prop_value(struct vcardparser_state *state)
661: {
662:     vcardproperty_kind prop_kind = vcardproperty_isa(state->prop);
663:     vcardvalue *value = NULL;
664: 
665:     NOTESTART();
666: 
667:     while (*state->p) {
668:         /* Handle control characters and break for NUL char */
669:         HANDLECTRL(state);
670: 
671:         switch (*state->p) {
672:         case '\\':
673:             /* seen in the wild - \n split by line wrapping */
674:             while (state->p[1] && strchr("\r\n", state->p[1])) {
675:                 if (state->p[1] == '\r') {
676:                     INC(1);
677:                 }
678:                 if (state->p[1] == '\n') {
679:                     if (state->p[2] != ' ' && state->p[2] != '\t') {
680:                         /* ignore unescaped backslash at end of line */
681:                         INC(2);
682:                         goto out;
683:                     }
684:                     INC(2);
685:                 }
686:             }
687:             if (state->p[1]) {
688:                 /* preserve escape sequences */
689:                 PUTC('\\');
690:                 PUTC(state->p[1]);
691:                 INC(2);
692:             } else {
693:                 /* ignore unescaped backslash at end of line */
694:                 INC(1);
695:                 goto out;
696:             }
697:             break;
698:         case '\r':
699:             INC(1);
700:             break; /* just skip */
701:         case '\n':
702:             if (state->p[1] == ' ' || state->p[1] == '\t') { /* wrapped line */
703:                 INC(2);
704:                 break;
705:             }
706:             /* otherwise it's the end of the value */
707:             INC(1);
708:             goto out;
709: 
710:         default:
711:             PUTC(*state->p);
712:             INC(1);
713:             break;
714:         }
715:     }
716: 
717: out:
718:     /* reaching the end of the file isn't a failure here,
719:      * it's just another type of end-of-value */
720: 
721:     /* repair critical property values */
722:     if (prop_kind == VCARD_VERSION_PROPERTY) {
723:         buf_trim(&state->buf);
724:         state->version = state->prop;
725:     }
726: 
727:     if (state->value_kind == VCARD_TEXTLIST_VALUE) {
728:         char sep = vcardproperty_is_structured(prop_kind) ? ';' : ',';
729:         vcardstrarray *textlist =
730:             vcardtextlist_new_from_string(buf_cstring(&state->buf), sep);
731:         if (textlist) {
732:             value = vcardvalue_new_textlist(textlist);
733:         }
734:     } else {
735:         value = vcardvalue_new_from_string(state->value_kind,
736:                                            buf_cstring(&state->buf));
737:     }
738: 
739:     if (!value) {
740:         return PE_VALUE_INVALID;
741:     }
742: 
743:     vcardproperty_set_value(state->prop, value);
744:     buf_reset(&state->buf);
745: 
746:     return 0;
747: }

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),

## [4.0.0] - Unreleased

This is a major release and is **not** source or binary compatible with version 3.x.

Please see [Version 4 Migration Guide](docs/MigrationGuide_to_4.md)
for details about API changes since libical 3.x.

### Added

- REUSE compliant licensing
- Supports multi-valued parameters (DELEGATED-FROM, DELEGATED-TO, MEMBER, DISPLAY, FEATURE, etc)
- Adds java bindings
- Brand new icalvcard library that follows the libical API.
- draft-ietf-calext-eventpub-extensions-19 (RFC 9073) support added
- draft-ietf-calext-valarm-extensions-07 (RFC 9074) support added
- Added support for Event Publishing (RFC 9073) and VALARM (RFC 9074) Extensions
- New CMake option "LIBICAL_ENABLE_64BIT_ICALTIME_T" to use 64-bit time_t implementations
   on 32-bit systems (where available and supported.  Windows-only so far)
- GEO property has arbitrary precision (values are internally stored as strings, not doubles)
- Allow previous recurrence iteration
- icalparser_ctrl setting defines how to handle invalid CONTROL characters during parsing
- Full support for `BYSETPOS`, i.e. remove the limitation to MONTHLY and YEARLY frequencies
- An API for setting/getting internal library limits (`icallimit_set` and `icallimit_get`)

### Changed

- Built-in timezones updated to tzdata2025c to include historical data
- Requires MSVC 2013 or higher (when building on Windows with MSVC)
- Requires CMake v3.20.0 or higher
- For the C++ bindings, requires a C++11 compliant C++ compiler
- libical-glib requires glib 2.38 or higher
- libical-glib requires a C11 compliant C compiler
- Replace gtk-doc with gi-docgen to produce libical-glib developer documentation
- libical-glib API is considered stable; no longer need to define LIBICAL_GLIB_UNSTABLE_API=1
   before including <libical-glib/libical-glib.h>
- By default, only shared libraries are built; to get static libraries one must invoke
  separate build using the CMake `-DLIBICAL_STATIC=True` option.
- CMake option -DGOBJECT_INTROSPECTION=True by default.
- `icaltzutil_get_zone_directory()` can use the TZDIR environment to find system zoneinfo
- `icaltimezone_set_tzid_prefix()` now allows setting an empty tzid prefix.
- `icaldurationtype_from_int` and `icaldurationtype_as_int` have been renamed to
    `icaldurationtype_from_seconds` and `icaldurationtype_as_seconds`, respectively.

### Deprecated

- The icalvcal library is deprecated and will be removed sometime in the 4.x series.
   Please port your icalvcal code to use icalvcard instead.

- Several CMake options are renamed in favor of a "namespaced" equivalent.
  Please port your buildscripts to the new CMake option names.
  A complete list is provided in this "CMake options" section of the
  [Version 4 Migration Guide](docs/MigrationGuide_to_4.md)

205: /* This returns where the start of the next line should be. chars_left does
206:    not include the trailing '\0'. */
207: static const size_t MAX_LINE_LEN = 75;
208: 
209: static char *get_next_line_start(char *line_start, size_t chars_left)
210: {
211:     char *pos;
212: 
213:     /* If we have 74 chars or less left, we can output all of them.
214:        we return a pointer to the '\0' at the end of the string. */
215:     if (chars_left < MAX_LINE_LEN) {
216:         return line_start + chars_left;
217:     }
218: 
219:     /* Now we jump to the last possible character of the line, and step back
220:        trying to find a ';' ':' or ' '. If we find one, we return the character
221:        after it. */
222:     pos = line_start + MAX_LINE_LEN - 2;
223:     while (pos > line_start) {
224:         if (*pos == ';' || *pos == ':' || *pos == ' ') {
225:             return pos + 1;
226:         }
227:         pos--;
228:     }
229:     /* Now try to split on a UTF-8 boundary defined as a 7-bit
230:        value or as a byte with the two high-most bits set:
231:        11xxxxxx.  See https://czyborra.com/utf/ */
232: 
233:     pos = line_start + MAX_LINE_LEN - 1;
234:     while (pos > line_start) {
235:         /* plain ascii */
236:         if ((*pos & 128) == 0) {
237:             return pos;
238:         }
239: 
240:         /* utf8 escape byte */
241:         if ((*pos & 192) == 192) {
242:             return pos;
243:         }
244: 
245:         pos--;
246:     }
247: 
248:     /* Give up, just break at 74 chars (the 75th char is the space at
249:        the start of the line).  */
250: 
251:     return line_start + MAX_LINE_LEN - 1;
252: }

254: /** This splits the property into lines less than 75 octets long (as
255:  *  specified in RFC6350). It tries to split after a ';' if it can.
256:  *  It returns a tmp buffer.  NOTE: I'm not sure if it matters if we
257:  *  split a line in the middle of a UTF-8 character. It probably won't
258:  *  look nice in a text editor.
259:  */
260: static char *fold_property_line(char *text)
261: {
262:     size_t buf_size, len;
263:     ssize_t chars_left;
264:     char *buf, *buf_ptr, *line_start, *next_line_start;
265:     int first_line;
266: 
267:     /* Start with a buffer twice the size of our property line, so we almost
268:        certainly won't overflow it. */
269:     len = strlen(text);
270:     buf_size = len * 2;
271:     buf = icalmemory_new_buffer(buf_size);
272:     buf_ptr = buf;
273: 
274:     /* Step through the text, finding each line to add to the output. */
275:     line_start = text;
276:     chars_left = (ssize_t)len;
277:     first_line = 1;
278:     for (;;) {
279:         if (chars_left <= 0) {
280:             break;
281:         }
282: 
283:         /* This returns the first character for the next line. */
284:         next_line_start = get_next_line_start(line_start, (size_t)chars_left);
285: 
286:         /* If this isn't the first line, we need to output a newline and space
287:            first. */
288:         if (!first_line) {
289:             icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, "\r\n ");
290:         }
291:         first_line = 0;
292: 
293:         /* This adds the line to our tmp buffer. We temporarily place a '\0'
294:            in text, so we can copy the line in one go. */
295:         char ch = *next_line_start;
296:         *next_line_start = '\0';
297:         icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, line_start);
298:         *next_line_start = ch;
299: 
300:         /* Now we move on to the next line. */
301:         chars_left -= (next_line_start - line_start);
302:         line_start = next_line_start;
303:     }
304: 
305:     return buf;
306: }

308: /* Determine what VALUE parameter to include. The VALUE parameters
309:    are ignored in the normal parameter printing ( the block after
310:    this one, so we need to do it here */
311: static const char *vcardproperty_get_value_kind(vcardproperty *prop,
312:                                                 const vcardvalue *value)
313: {
314:     const char *kind_string = NULL;
315:     if (!prop) {
316:         return kind_string;
317:     }
318:     vcardvalue_kind kind = VCARD_NO_VALUE;
319:     vcardparameter *val_param =
320:         vcardproperty_get_first_parameter(prop, VCARD_VALUE_PARAMETER);
321:     vcardproperty_version version = vcardcomponent_get_version(prop->parent);
322: 
323:     if (version == VCARD_VERSION_NONE) {
324:         version = VCARD_VERSION_30;
325:     }
326: 
327:     if (val_param) {
328:         kind = vcardparameter_value_to_value_kind(vcardparameter_get_value(val_param));
329:     }
330: 
331:     if (kind == VCARD_NO_VALUE && vcardproperty_isa(prop) != VCARD_X_PROPERTY) {
332:         kind = vcardvalue_isa(value);
333:     }
334: 
335:     /* Try to omit VERSION-dependent default VALUE kinds */
336:     switch (vcardproperty_isa(prop)) {
337:     case VCARD_GEO_PROPERTY:
338:         /* v3 default: VALUE=STRUCTURED
339:          * v4 default: VALUE=URL
340:          */
341:         if (kind != VCARD_X_VALUE) {
342:             kind = VCARD_NO_VALUE;
343:         }
344:         break;
345: 
346:     case VCARD_KEY_PROPERTY:
347:     case VCARD_LOGO_PROPERTY:
348:     case VCARD_PHOTO_PROPERTY:
349:     case VCARD_SOUND_PROPERTY:
350:         /* v3 default: VALUE=BINARY (ENCODING=b parameter)
351:          * v4 default: VALUE=URL
352:          */
353:         if (version == VCARD_VERSION_40 ||
354:             vcardproperty_get_first_parameter(prop, VCARD_ENCODING_PARAMETER)) {
355:             kind = VCARD_NO_VALUE;
356:         }
357:         break;
358: 
359:     case VCARD_ANNIVERSARY_PROPERTY:
360:     case VCARD_BDAY_PROPERTY:
361:     case VCARD_DEATHDATE_PROPERTY:
362:         /* TIME is v4 specific.
363:          * All other types are self-evident.
364:          */
365:         if (version == VCARD_VERSION_40 &&
366:             (kind == VCARD_TIME_VALUE || kind == VCARD_DATEANDORTIME_VALUE)) {
367:             kind = VCARD_NO_VALUE;
368:         } else if (kind == VCARD_DATE_VALUE || kind == VCARD_DATETIME_VALUE) {
369:             kind = VCARD_NO_VALUE;
370:         }
371:         break;
372: 
373:     case VCARD_TZ_PROPERTY:
374:         /* v3 default: VALUE=UTCOFFSET
375:          * v4 default: VALUE=TEXT
376:          */
377:         if (version == VCARD_VERSION_40) {
378:             if (kind == VCARD_TEXT_VALUE) {
379:                 kind = VCARD_NO_VALUE;
380:             }
381:         } else if (kind == VCARD_UTCOFFSET_VALUE) {
382:             kind = VCARD_NO_VALUE;
383:         }
384:         break;
385: 
386:     case VCARD_UID_PROPERTY:
387:         /* v3 default: VALUE=TEXT
388:          * v4 default: VALUE=URI
389:          */
390:         if (version == VCARD_VERSION_40) {
391:             if (kind == VCARD_URI_VALUE) {
392:                 kind = VCARD_NO_VALUE;
393:             }
394:         } else {
395:             kind = VCARD_NO_VALUE;
396:         }
397:         break;
398: 
399:     default:
400:         break;
401:     }
402: 
403:     if (kind != VCARD_NO_VALUE &&
404:         !vcardproperty_value_kind_is_default(prop->kind, kind)) {
405:         /* Not the default, so it must be specified */
406:         kind_string = vcardvalue_kind_to_string(kind);
407:     } else {
408:         /* Don't include the VALUE parameter at all */
409:     }
410: 
411:     return kind_string;
412: }

423: char *vcardproperty_as_vcard_string_r(vcardproperty *prop)
424: {
425:     vcardparameter *param;
426: 
427:     /* Create new buffer that we can append names, parameters and a
428:      * value to, and reallocate as needed.
429:      */
430: 
431:     const char *property_name = 0;
432:     size_t buf_size = 1024;
433:     char *buf;
434:     char *buf_ptr;
435:     const vcardvalue *value;
436:     char *out_buf;
437:     const char *kind_string = 0;
438:     const char newline[] = "\r\n";
439: 
440:     icalerror_check_arg_rz((prop != 0), "prop");
441: 
442:     buf = icalmemory_new_buffer(buf_size);
443:     buf_ptr = buf;
444: 
445:     /* Append property name */
446: 
447:     if (prop->kind == VCARD_X_PROPERTY && prop->x_name != 0) {
448:         property_name = prop->x_name;
449:     } else {
450:         property_name = vcardproperty_kind_to_string(prop->kind);
451:     }
452: 
453:     if (property_name == 0) {
454:         icalerror_warn("Got a property of an unknown kind.");
455:         icalmemory_free_buffer(buf);
456:         return 0;
457:     }
458: 
459:     if (prop->group != 0) {
460:         icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, prop->group);
461:         icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, ".");
462:     }
463: 
464:     icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, property_name);
465: 
466:     value = vcardproperty_get_value(prop);
467:     kind_string = vcardproperty_get_value_kind(prop, value);
468:     if (kind_string != 0) {
469:         icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, ";VALUE=");
470:         icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, kind_string);
471:     }
472: 
473:     /* Append parameters */
474:     for (param = vcardproperty_get_first_parameter(prop, VCARD_ANY_PARAMETER);
475:          param != 0; param = vcardproperty_get_next_parameter(prop, VCARD_ANY_PARAMETER)) {
476:         vcardparameter_kind kind = vcardparameter_isa(param);
477: 
478:         kind_string = vcardparameter_as_vcard_string_r(param);
479: 
480:         if (kind_string == 0) {
481:             icalerror_warn("Got a parameter of unknown kind for the following property");
482: 
483:             icalerror_warn((property_name) ? property_name : "(NULL)");
484:             continue;
485:         }
486: 
487:         if (kind == VCARD_VALUE_PARAMETER) {
488:             icalmemory_free_buffer((char *)kind_string);
489:             continue;
490:         }
491: 
492:         icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, ";");
493:         icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, kind_string);
494:         icalmemory_free_buffer((char *)kind_string);
495:     }
496: 
497:     /* Append value */
498: 
499:     icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, ":");
500: 
501:     if (value != 0) {
502:         char *str = vcardvalue_as_vcard_string_r(value);
503: 
504:         if (str != 0) {
505:             icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, str);
506:         } else if (!icalproperty_get_allow_empty_properties()) {
507:             icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, "ERROR: No Value");
508:         }
509:         icalmemory_free_buffer(str);
510:     } else if (!icalproperty_get_allow_empty_properties()) {
511:         icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, "ERROR: No Value");
512:     }
513: 
514:     icalmemory_append_string(&buf, &buf_ptr, &buf_size, newline);
515: 
516:     /* We now use a function to fold the line properly every 75 characters.
517:        That function also adds the newline for us. */
518:     out_buf = fold_property_line(buf);
519: 
520:     icalmemory_free_buffer(buf);
521: 
522:     return out_buf;
523: }

615: char *vcardproperty_get_parameter_as_string_r(vcardproperty *prop, const char *name)
616: {
617:     vcardparameter_kind kind;
618:     vcardparameter *param;
619:     char *str;
620:     char *pv, *t;
621:     char *pvql;
622:     char *pvqr;
623: 
624:     icalerror_check_arg_rz((prop != 0), "prop");
625:     icalerror_check_arg_rz((name != 0), "name");
626: 
627:     kind = vcardparameter_string_to_kind(name);
628: 
629:     if (kind == VCARD_NO_PARAMETER) {
630:         /* icalenum_string_to_parameter_kind will set icalerrno */
631:         return 0;
632:     }
633: 
634:     for (param = vcardproperty_get_first_parameter(prop, kind);
635:          param != 0; param = vcardproperty_get_next_parameter(prop, kind)) {
636:         if (kind == VCARD_X_PARAMETER) {
637:             if (strcmp(vcardparameter_get_xname(param), name) == 0) {
638:                 break;
639:             }
640:         } else if (kind == VCARD_IANA_PARAMETER) {
641:             if (strcmp(vcardparameter_get_iana_name(param), name) == 0) {
642:                 break;
643:             }
644:         } else {
645:             break;
646:         }
647:     }
648: 
649:     if (param == 0) {
650:         return 0;
651:     }
652: 
653:     str = vcardparameter_as_vcard_string_r(param);
654: 
655:     t = strchr(str, '=');
656: 
657:     if (t == 0) {
658:         icalerror_set_errno(ICAL_INTERNAL_ERROR);
659:         icalmemory_free_buffer(str);
660:         return 0;
661:     }
662: 
663:     /* Strip the property name and the equal sign */
664:     pv = icalmemory_strdup(t + 1);
665:     icalmemory_free_buffer(str);
666: 
667:     /* Is the string quoted? */
668:     pvql = strchr(pv, '"');
669:     if (pvql == 0) {
670:         return (pv); /* No quotes?  Return it immediately. */
671:     }
672: 
673:     /* Strip everything up to the first quote */
674:     str = icalmemory_strdup(pvql + 1);
675:     icalmemory_free_buffer(pv);
676: 
677:     /* Search for the end quote */
678:     pvqr = strrchr(str, '"');
679:     if (pvqr == 0) {
680:         icalerror_set_errno(ICAL_INTERNAL_ERROR);
681:         icalmemory_free_buffer(str);
682:         return 0;
683:     }
684: 
685:     *pvqr = '\0';
686:     return str;
687: }
